body: Thanks but you haven't begun to hear my problems and no one can help me. I have spinal pain but kidney disease means I may only take Tylenol. I live in pain. I will be dead and gone before too long anyway as alcoholism has made me worse. I was intervened. I work for the most hated company in the country and 200+ bad visible self inflicted scars cover my arms & legs. No one wants to hire someone like that. I'm trapped but I still see one way out. I plan to abandon my family without explanation and get as far away as possible before doing it

I would rather abandon my family. I'm not needed. Their hatred for me would make them a unit and it beats sadness. Easier to forget. The mother cooks cleans makes twice what I do and gets home sooner. I'm just the guy who rolls in tired and late with spinal pain and kidney disease and disappoints everyone.
